How we hire

Our hiring process is four stages and takes about two weeks. We tell you where you stand after every stage, and we do not ask for free work.

  1. Recruiter screen (30 minutes)

    Logistics, compensation range, and what you are looking for. No technical questions.

  2. Take-home exercise (three hours, paid)

    A small dispatch assignment problem against a real-shaped dataset. We care about how you handle the messy rows, not whether you finish every extension.

  3. System design interview (60 minutes)

    We walk through ingesting truck telemetry at scale and ask you to defend the trade-offs you pick around ordering, back-pressure and replay.

  4. Values interview (45 minutes)

    Two people who will not work with you day to day ask about disagreement, ownership and how you have mentored other engineers.

We do not run whiteboard algorithm rounds. We stopped in 2021 and have not missed them.
